title: DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter
abstract: arXiv:2610.17666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for multi-turn agents relies on sparse terminal rewards that say little about individual steps. Within-group step comparisons depend on reliable state matching and sufficiently diverse sampled outcomes, while direct step scoring may require costly external evaluators, human annotations, or task-specific heuristics. We introduce DeltaTTG to learn a reusable progress signal through a shared progress meter, using low-cost supervision from diverse policies' recorded trajectories without task-specific progress rules. Its supervision target, Token-to-Go (TTG), the number of tokens remaining to be generated until task completion, serves as an observable proxy for remaining completion effort. translated_title: DeltaTTG：使用Token-to-Go进度计量器训练多轮智能体
translated_abstract: 针对多轮智能体的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）依赖于稀疏的终端奖励，这些奖励对各个步骤的表现几乎不提供任何信息。组内步骤比较依赖于可靠的状态匹配和足够多样的采样结果，而直接的步骤评分可能需要昂贵的外部评估器、人工标注或任务特定的启发式规则。我们提出DeltaTTG，通过一个共享的进度计量器学习可复用的进度信号，利用来自不同策略记录轨迹的低成本监督，无需任务特定的进度规则。其监督目标Token-to-Go（TTG）——即直到任务完成剩余需要生成的token数量——作为剩余完成工作量的可观测代理指标。在actor训练过程中，冻结的计量器估计值的变化会在不改变奖励的情况下，将基于结果导出的优势在各步骤之间重新分配，同时保持每条轨迹的优势符号和token平均幅度……
tldr: DeltaTTG通过学习一个预测“剩余待生成token数”（TTG）的共享进度计量器，将稀疏的终端奖励转化为逐步骤的进度信号，在无需人工标注、外部评估器或任务特定规则的情况下，对多轮智能体的优势在各步骤间重新分配。
en_tdlr: DeltaTTG learns a reusable shared progress meter that predicts Token-to-Go (the number of tokens remaining until task completion), redistributing outcome-derived advantages across steps for multi-turn agent RLVR without task-specific rules, human annotations, or costly external evaluators.
